enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Remain motionless. Breathe rhythmically. Occasionally turn to the side. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting ready
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator and take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and pan. Crack eggs into bowl and whisk. Turn on stove and pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs and turn off stove. Fill kettle with water and turn on. Pour boiling water into cup and add tea bag. Sit at table and eat breakfast. Drink tea. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open door. Walk out. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients and completing clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Put on scrubs. Attend morning briefing. Check patient charts. Visit patient rooms. Take vital signs. Administer medications. Assist with procedures. Update patient records. Consult with colleagues. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to duties. Attend afternoon meeting. Review test results. Communicate with patients' families. Complete paperwork. Prepare for shift change. Handover to next shift. Leave hospital.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Remove work clothes and place in hamper. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body with soap. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on clean clothes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, cleaning up dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables and meat. Turn on stove. Add meat and vegetables. Stir and cook. Turn off stove. Serve onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Scrape plate into trash. Place dishes in sink. Turn on tap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place in drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to check messages and review health-related study material
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open email. Check messages. Reply to messages. Open study material. Read. Take notes. Highlight text. Search for related articles. Read. Close study material. Shut down computer. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Running the washing machine and preparing laundry for the next day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Load dirty clothes. Add detergent. Close washing machine. Press start. Open dryer. Load wet clothes. Close dryer. Press start. Prepare next day's clothes. Fold clothes. Place in drawer.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Occasionally turn. Continue sleeping.
